17156               	; 	INCLUDE "art.bas"
17157               	; 	' Keystone Kapers art -- GENERATED by assets/genart.py. Do not edit; regenerate.
17158               	; 	'
17159               	; 	' EVERY SPRITE IS 16x16: sprite size and magnification are GLOBAL on the
17160               	; 	' TMS9918, so small objects are drawn small INSIDE a 16x16 box rather than
17161               	; 	' being small sprites.
17162               	; 	'
17163               	; 	' EVERY 8-PX OBJECT SITS IN ROWS 8-15 OF ITS BOX, ducked Kelly included, so
17164               	; 	' one rule places them all: bottom edge = y + 16, and a thing resting on the
17165               	; 	' floor is at y = FLOORY - 16.
17166               	; 	'
17167               	; 	' Sprite bytes are QUADRANT-ORDERED: 16 rows of the left half, then 16 of
17168               	; 	' the right. Every block is an EVEN number of bytes -- an odd DATA BYTE run
17169               	; 	' silently misaligns every word table after it (CLAUDE.md 3A).
17170               	;
17171               	; spr_kelly:	' Kelly: RIGHT hat/face/the four merged run bodies/duck hat/face/body, then the same LEFT (+36). The run bodies carry tunic AND legs, so a frame is one sprite. Patterns 0..68

18285               	;
18286               	; 	' -------------------------------------------------- scanner canvas
18287               	; 	' Chars 208-255: 16 cols x 3 rows over screen rows 21-23. Blank to start;
18288               	; 	' dots are plotted by VPOKEing the PATTERN table (rows 21-23 sit in the
18289               	; 	' third screen third, so every scanner pattern is at base 4096).
18290               	;
18291               	; 	' --------------------------------------------------- font colours
18292               	; 	' Chars 32-90, EIGHT bytes each. Without this the font keeps whatever
18293               	; 	' CVBasic left in the colour table, which on a green store made the HUD
18294               	; 	' unreadable.
18295               	;
18296               	; scan_col3:	' one 8-byte block per canvas row: 4 px of GREY margin, then a 3 px band of furniture GREY and a yellow floor line, per 4 px level, on dark green. The Kop and the crook are coloured PER CHARACTER at run time -- see scan_set
18297               cvb_SCAN_COL3

18412               	; 	INCLUDE "store.bas"
18413               	; 	' Keystone Kapers store -- GENERATED by assets/genstore.py. Do not edit.
18414               	; 	'
18415               	; 	' EIGHT band templates of 5 rows x 32 cols (160 bytes each) plus a 32-byte
18416               	; 	' index over (level, screen). The whole 8-screen, 4-level building is about
18417               	; 	' 1.3 KB instead of the 5,120 bytes it would cost to store literally.
18418               	; 	'
18419               	; 	' All eight templates are ONE contiguous block under ONE label, so a band
18420               	; 	' blit is
18421               	; 	'     SCREEN stor_tpl, tpl*160, toprow*32, 32, 5, 32
18422               	; 	' with no label ladder -- SCREEN needs a literal label and a label cannot be
18423               	; 	' chosen by a variable, which is why RallyX needed a 4-way IF over its maze
18424               	; 	' tables. One block sidesteps it.
18425               	; 	'
18426               	; 	' 160 is EVEN, so this cannot leave the location counter odd and misalign
18427               	; 	' the word tables defined after it.
18428               	; 	'
18429               	; 	' template ids:
18430               	; 	'   0 T_AISLE_A
18431               	; 	'   1 T_AISLE_B
18432               	; 	'   2 T_ESC_W
18433               	; 	'   3 T_ESC_E
18434               	; 	'   4 T_ELEV
18435               	; 	'   5 T_ROOF0
18436               	; 	'   6 T_ROOF1
18437               	; 	'   7 T_ROOF2
18438               	; 	'   8 T_ROOF3
18439               	; 	'   9 T_ROOF4
18440               	; 	'   10 T_ROOF5
18441               	; 	'   11 T_ROOF6
18442               	; 	'   12 T_ROOF7
18443               	; 	'   13 T_END_W
18444               	; 	'   14 T_END_E

19062               	;
19063               	; 	' THE SKYLINE'S LAST BAND WITHOUT ITS YELLOW, high nibble ink, low nibble
19064               	; 	' paper, one byte a scan line -- the same shape genart emits into
19065               	; 	' store_col. SKY2 is white-on-9 throughout instead of turning to paper 10
19066               	; 	' at row 4; BLDGL holds its blue one row longer and then meets its own
19067               	; 	' grey wall. Both are the generated bytes with 10 replaced by 9 and
19068               	; 	' nothing else changed. See setup_rest.
19069               	; #if NES
19070               	; nes_sky2c:
19071               	; 	DATA BYTE $F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9
19072               	; nes_bldlc:
19073               	; 	DATA BYTE $B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$BE,$BE,$BE
19074               	; #endif
19075               	;
19076               	; 	' THE IN-GAME FONT'S COLOUR, one byte a scan line and eight a character for
19077               	; 	' all 59 of them. $F4 is white on dark blue -- ink index 3, paper index 1 --
19078               	; 	' and which colours those are is then the attribute table's business, per
19079               	; 	' region: dark blue behind the HUD, the store's green behind a message box.
19080               	; 	'
19081               	; 	' 472 bytes of one repeated value. That reads like waste and is the cheap
19082               	; 	' option: ROM is three budgets here and this is not the scarce one, while
19083               	; 	' the alternative is a second font (impossible -- only eleven free codes)
19084               	; 	' or a new uploader parameter (no RAM -- two bytes left).
